title: FDGR evidence-qualified digital-twin delivery program
description:
Purpose
Deliver FDGR as an evidence-grade, agent-native operating substrate that turns authorized drone/camera observations into immutable, uncertainty-bearing geometry and semantic digital twins. The product is the safe loop fdgr.open_session -> orient -> query/propose/compare -> commit -> watch/cancel -> verify/reconcile -> explain/handoff/doctor, not a loose set of crate APIs or a mesh generator.

Non-negotiable constitution
- Freeze semantics before implementation; create a deterministic reference path before optimized, adaptive, or model-heavy paths.
- Preserve original bytes and exact provenance. Derived assets never overwrite originals. Every coherent generation follows reserve -> materialize -> verify -> publish and exposes request durability, process acceptance, observed output, verified output, publication, and semantic completion separately.
- Make clocks, capture epochs, coordinate frames, calibration, scale, uncertainty, privacy scope, coverage, and compatibility first-class typed evidence. Never emit metric claims for relative-only or merely estimated scale. Reject non-finite numbers, invalid rotations, singular calibration, unbounded coordinates, mixed generations, and implicit frame conversions.
- Preserve Observation, Hypothesis, Resolved, Rejected, and Indeterminate. Model/caption/memory/recommendation outputs are authority-free proposals. Absence requires a coverage and detectability witness; critical assets require elevated review gates.
- Use the pinned edition-2024 nightly, a strict crate DAG, safe Rust with #![forbid(unsafe_code)], typed errors, stable IDs, canonical ordering, lower_snake_case public vocabulary, and fdgr.<name>/1 payload schemas. Shipping code forbids unwrap, expect, panic!, todo!, unimplemented!, and dbg!.
- Asupersync is the only in-process async runtime. All asynchronous work belongs to a region, accepts &Cx, and supports cancel -> drain -> reconcile -> finalize with no detached descendants. When admitted for research, reference, or bootstrap use, ffmpeg and model runtimes remain bounded external sidecars with sealed manifests, content-addressed inputs, no-network defaults, output validation, and descendant cleanup; WP-000/N06 defines native production-maturity and oracle-retirement gates, and no release silently treats those sidecars as permanent shipping foundations. Forbidden dependencies/FFI remain forbidden.
- Operate only authorized devices/accounts; begin read-only; never bypass pairing, authentication, encryption, access controls, or geographic restrictions; never expose arbitrary packet injection or flight commands.
- Project every public result through one anchor-bound Agent Turn Packet, the abstraction tower, four synchronized ledgers, objective/question graph, exactly one Decision Frame for material decisions, stable attention/epistemic debt, typed spatial handles, explicit budgets/recovery/continuations, and authority-free handoffs.

Delivery structure
The current planning snapshot contains nine workstreams and registry packages WP-000..WP-047; WP-000/N06 must add any missing native-maturity or device-safety packages to the normative registry before implementation. Each package has contract/reference, production implementation, integration/recovery, adversarial verification, and local qualification subtasks. Work-package and task blockers reproduce registries/work_packages.toml. Registry IDs, gates, TEST families, SLOs, risks, open questions, schemas, and qualification lanes are binding inputs; prose compactness never weakens them.

Evidence and release rule
Completion requires retained deterministic fixtures, unit/property/differential tests, fault campaigns, end-to-end scripts with structured high-signal logs, input/source/toolchain/model/hardware/policy roots, output digests, timings, budgets, omissions, and terminal receipts. Same-binary semantic equality precedes performance comparison. IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS must change with earned/lost capability. Local Doodlestein receipts are the release authority; hosted CI is informational only. Negative evidence remains visible and no aggregate percentage may imply readiness.

Integration milestone closure
FDGR-VS-00 must first reconcile the normative work-package DAG with staged delivery without losing any capability. Then FDGR-VS-01 through FDGR-VS-06 qualify, in order, the model-free recorded reference path, witnessed metric exterior, bounded semantic asset, authorized live-to-original succession, multi-agent repeated capture, and evidence-gated accretion. These are public-path integration gates over qualified WP outputs, not alternate implementation paths.

## Background
The outcome, rationale, user impact, and parent/package context above are the binding background for this bead. This bead exists at a distinct contract, implementation, integration, verification, qualification, or cross-package milestone boundary; it must not be collapsed into source presence or a neighboring task.

## Technical Approach
Execute the required deliverables and working method above in registered dependency order. Preserve every stated invariant, authority boundary, exact anchor/root, typed error and recovery path, deterministic ordering rule, resource bound, migration concern, and reserve -> materialize -> verify -> publish stage. Update normative contracts before coding around a missing prerequisite.

## Success Criteria
All packages in the repaired normative registry (WP-000 through WP-047 at this snapshot plus any WP-000/N06 additions) satisfy their registered terminal gates; the dependency graph remains acyclic and registry-faithful; every advertised capability has current positive local Doodlestein receipts plus visible negative evidence for unqualified dimensions; a cold agent can orient, choose, commit, watch, verify, reconcile, and hand off without reading source or replaying a transcript; no hosted badge, model output, recommendation, memory, or derived presentation is treated as authority. FDGR-VS-00 is resolved with six no-future-slice closure receipts, and FDGR-VS-01 through FDGR-VS-06 each pass their named public-path E2E script and retained exact-root milestone receipt in dependency order; open or failed slice evidence prevents program closure.

## Test Plan
Run the named unit, property, differential, adversarial, fault, migration, public-path E2E, and local qualification evidence required above as applicable. Structured receipts retain exact inputs and source/toolchain/model/policy/hardware roots, schedules/seeds, transitions, budgets/timings, output digests, omissions, recovery/drain, and terminal verdict; unsupported or failed evidence remains visible.

## Considerations
Treat the binding invariants, risks, open questions, evidence boundary, privacy/custody/scale/coverage/authority rules, and agent operating model above as hard constraints. A hosted badge, process exit, adapter acknowledgement, model confidence, rendered appearance, or partial publication cannot substitute for semantic completion. Reconcile IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS whenever capability is earned or lost.

Preserve every stated invariant, authority boundary, exact anchor/root, typed error and recovery path, deterministic ordering rule, resource bound, migration concern, and reserve -> materialize -> verify -> publish stage. Update normative contracts before coding around a missing prerequisite.

## Acceptance Criteria
GATE-000 (Constitution frozen): Registries parse, stable IDs are unique, dependency policy passes, and no implementation claim exceeds evidence. Completion also requires passing the named unit/property/differential, fault, and end-to-end evidence; retained current local receipts; negative evidence; and a status/registry/docs reconciliation with no overclaim. GATE-000 is not earned until GALG-001/GATE-709 is resolved in the normative registry and the expanded no-dangling-reference validator passes against the exact source root.

Structured receipts retain exact inputs and source/toolchain/model/policy/hardware roots, schedules/seeds, transitions, budgets/timings, output digests, omissions, recovery/drain, and terminal verdict; unsupported or failed evidence remains visible.

## Considerations
Treat the binding invariants, risks, open questions, evidence boundary, privacy/custody/scale/coverage/authority rules, and agent operating model above as hard constraints. A hosted badge, process exit, adapter acknowledgement, model confidence, rendered appearance, or partial publication cannot substitute for semantic completion. Reconcile IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS whenever capability is earned or lost.

title: WP-000/N06: Close cross-document contradictions and prove requirement-complete contract retirement
description:
## Background

Repeated full-document, registry, and Bead audits found material requirements that the original lifecycle graph mentioned only indirectly or not at all. The gaps are not stylistic. They permit incompatible meanings of production, device authority, epistemic state, question closure, durability, operation vocabulary, architecture ownership, and release readiness.

Known contradictions now include: external FFmpeg/Python workers described both as planned sidecars and as temporary reference/bootstrap oracles requiring native safe-Rust production paths; future camera/gimbal/assisted-flight stages despite the current read-only device constitution; dangling and heterogeneous registry references/record shapes; two disagreeing dependency-policy sources; legacy camelCase/.v1 examples; incompatible epistemic/question/recovery vocabularies and profile token bounds; an obsolete thirteen-operation agent surface beside the canonical eleven; prose-only D0-D9, compatibility, spool, custody, effect, model, and release maturity ladders; three B1-B12 namespaces with different row meanings; and three target crate graphs.

This is a planning-space blocker. It does not authorize implementation of media codecs, inference, device control, or registry edits by inference. It requires the normative sources and Bead graph to choose and encode one coherent contract before production work proceeds.

## Technical Approach

Close all nine child beads:

1. N06.1 repairs registry schemas, references, and dependency-policy authority.
2. N06.2 canonicalizes wire examples, payload identities, and continuity prose.
3. N06.3 registers native media/model production maturity and external-oracle retirement.
4. N06.4 reconciles camera, gimbal, assisted-flight, and current constitutional authority.
5. N06.5 freezes CD-01..CD-32 and the exact 21-step integration-order traceability.
6. N06.6 freezes orthogonal public state axes, question/claim/response/recovery vocabularies, profile bounds, publication verbs, and the eleven-operation mapping.
7. N06.7 registers device, compatibility, spool, custody, publication, effect, worker, and release maturity/proof state machines.
8. N06.8 reconciles all leapfrog namespaces, named architecture aliases, and the three draft target crate graphs into one strict staged DAG.
9. N06.9 performs requirement-level retirement of all 74 Markdown sources and proves a cold agent can execute from self-contained Beads plus machine registries.

Amend registries/work_packages.toml first when a missing implementation package or dependency boundary is discovered. Split only at a real dependency, authority, trust, format, failure, or verification boundary. Preserve every reference path, sidecar research lane, vertical slice, later capability, rejected shortcut, and negative-evidence boundary; classify and gate them rather than deleting them.

Every resolved choice records fact/design/hypothesis/target/deferred/rejected status; canonical ID and schema; owner WP/task and prerequisites; terminal gate, TEST/SLO/qualification evidence; migration/compatibility behavior; public capability maturity; Agent Turn Packet projection; and positive/negative/fault/E2E receipts. Generated traceability, bootstrap artifacts, Bead dependencies, and IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS move in the same coherent change.

N06.1 is the registry-authority prerequisite for N06.6 and N06.8. N06.7 additionally depends on N06.6 because maturity values must project through the canonical public state axes. N06.9 is the integration/closure audit and depends on N06.1-N06.8. WP-000/I02 and FDGR-VS-00 remain blocked until this epic and every child close.

## Success Criteria

All nine children close with one non-contradictory definition of shipping trust domain, sidecar/oracle status, native production maturity, device-control scope, dependency policy, registry shape, public vocabulary/state axes, maturity ladders, architecture names, target crate DAG, and staged integration.

Every CD-01..CD-32 decision, integration step 1..21, product and mechanism bet, material requirement in all 74 project Markdown files, registry ID, test/fault/qualification family, and current status boundary maps forward and backward to an owner, dependency closure, gate, and evidence path. Unsupported capabilities advertise unavailable/deferred status rather than disappearing or masquerading as ready. A future implementation agent no longer needs the original Markdown plans to reconstruct intent.

No implementation bead bypasses the repaired normative graph. No filename count, ID count, source presence, negative test, hosted badge, subprocess exit, provider acknowledgment, or upload is accepted as completeness by itself.

## Test Plan

Create and run scripts/e2e/normative_contract_coherence.sh as the aggregate planning gate. It includes:

- scripts/test_registry_contracts.py;
- scripts/test_document_examples.py;
- scripts/e2e/native_media_inference_maturity.sh;
- scripts/e2e/device_authority_refusal.sh;
- scripts/check_constitutional_traceability.py;
- scripts/test_public_state_vocabularies.py and scripts/e2e/state_axis_roundtrip.sh;
- scripts/test_maturity_state_machines.py and scripts/e2e/maturity_and_effect_transitions.sh;
- scripts/check_architecture_crosswalk.py and scripts/e2e/architecture_contract_projection.sh;
- scripts/check_document_requirement_retirement.py and scripts/e2e/bead_handoff_without_plan_docs.sh;
- repository, agent-contract, generated-traceability, work-package DAG, Bead reference/cycle, and IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS checks.

Deterministic negative fixtures cover dangling IDs, unknown/missing registry fields, divergent policy mirrors, noncanonical public names, collapsed state axes, skipped maturity stages, ambiguous B-labels, crate cycles/forbidden reachability, production backed only by an oracle, unadmitted device control, and removed/unowned source requirements. Logs retain exact source/contract/registry/work-graph roots, changed IDs, dependency closures, fixtures, transitions, budgets, output digests, omissions, and terminal verdict.

## Considerations

The constitutional deep dive overrides weaker language until the comprehensive plan is made coherent, but late targets do not become current functionality by appearing in that document. Initial operation remains local-first, manual-pilot, read-only for devices; models, recommendations, memory, and native inference remain authority-free proposals; external processes remain untrusted. Preserve orthogonal complexity explicitly rather than compressing it into one enum, one readiness percentage, or one oversized crate.
acceptance_criteria: All nine child audits close with mutually consistent registries, schemas, work graph, gates, tests, SLOs, ADRs, traceability, architecture crosswalk, maturity/state contracts, self-contained document retirement, and IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS; N06.9 proves cold-agent execution without Markdown plan access, and no implementation task can start from a contradictory or structurally under-specified contract.

title: WP-000/N06.1: Repair registry schemas, references, and dependency-policy authority
description:
## Background

The present validators parse 21 registries and check ID uniqueness, selected effect/schema/work-package links, and the WP DAG, but they do not validate each collection's required/allowed fields or typed IDs embedded in strings. This permits confirmed defects to pass:

- GALG-001 says its optimized candidate follows nonexistent GATE-709.
- CAP-PILOT-GUIDANCE and CAP-SPATIAL-EXPAND omit the authority and status fields used by every other capability.
- OPEN-026..OPEN-028 use a question field while OPEN-001..OPEN-025 use name plus statement.
- RISK-021..RISK-023 and operation_costs.toml introduce alternate row shapes without a declared tagged/versioned union.
- registries/dependency_allowlist.toml and architecture/dependency_allowlist.toml both claim closed-universe policy but differ in schema, naming, admitted sources, external processes, fundamental exceptions, and explicit forbidden entries. A reader cannot tell which is authoritative or whether one is a generated projection.

These are contract defects, not permission to guess the missing values.

## Technical Approach

Define machine-validated schemas for every registry row type, including required fields, allowed fields, enum vocabularies, uniqueness, ordering, cross-registry references, and version/migration rules. Normalize heterogeneous rows where one shape is intended; where a real tagged union is intended, name and validate each variant and ensure consumers handle it exhaustively. Extract typed ID-looking references from structured fields and designated prose fields such as optimized_candidate, and reject unknown IDs.

Choose one canonical dependency-policy registry. Make any second document a generated, provenance-bearing projection with deterministic parity checks, or retire it through an explicit migration. Reconcile std/core/alloc, exact fundamental exceptions, owned sources, external reference/bootstrap processes, forbidden runtimes/frameworks/ORM/FFI/in-process Python, features, transitive closure, source identities, admission evidence, and production_admitted state. Closed-universe semantics must remain fail-closed.

## Acceptance Criteria

GALG-001 references a real registered gate or a newly justified registered gate. Every capability has explicit authority and maturity; every open question has a human name and complete statement; every risk and operation-cost record conforms to an intentional versioned shape. All 21 registries have required/unknown-field enforcement, canonical stable ordering, exhaustive status vocabularies, and complete cross-reference checks. Exactly one dependency-policy source is normative and all mirrors are generated or parity-tested. Traceability and bootstrap generation consume the canonical forms without silently dropping variant rows.

No registry fix promotes capability readiness. IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS and self-description continue to report only evidenced maturity.

## Test Plan

Create scripts/test_registry_contracts.py and deterministic positive and negative fixtures for each registry type. Negative cases include missing required field, unknown field, invalid enum, duplicate ID, out-of-order record where ordering is contractual, dangling structured reference, dangling GATE-709-style prose reference, untagged heterogeneous variant, dependency-policy mirror drift, unpinned source/feature, forbidden transitive dependency, and an external process misclassified as production-admitted. Run repository validation twice to prove stable generated output and log exact fixture, registry digest, diagnostic ID/path, and verdict.

## Considerations

Do not force unrelated concepts into one shape merely for cosmetic uniformity; explicit tagged unions are acceptable when semantics differ. Conversely, do not let permissive parsing turn omissions into defaults. Registry status is evidence-bearing and must never be inferred from a title, source presence, or another document's prose.

## Steps to Reproduce

Run python3 scripts/validate_repo.py on the current tree: it reports success even though registries/graph_algorithms.toml names nonexistent GATE-709. Compare the two CAP records and OPEN-026..OPEN-028 with their peers, then diff registries/dependency_allowlist.toml against architecture/dependency_allowlist.toml; the incompatible shapes and policy sets are accepted because the validator has no per-collection required-field schema or policy-authority parity check.
## Confirmed Graph-Algorithm Cardinality and Stable-ID Defect

The numbered FrankenNetworkX source contract defines 22 semantic families. The current graph registry has only GALG-001..GALG-021: it maps GALG-019 to treewidth/elimination, GALG-020 to temporal graphs, and GALG-021 to submodular selection. The source family order is 19 tree decomposition/factor/elimination, 20 geometric and visibility graphs, 21 submodular selection/diversity, and 22 temporal graphs/persistence. Therefore geometric/visibility graphs are absent, and source ordinal is being confused with registry identity.

Published IDs MUST NOT be renumbered. Preserve GALG-020 temporal and GALG-021 submodular as stable identities; add GALG-022 for geometric/visibility graphs (or an ADR-approved new stable ID with the same non-renumbering property), and record explicit source_family_ordinal values/crosswalks so source order 20/21/22 is not inferred from registry number. Update the traceability index, owners, gates, tests, schemas and retirement receipts. Negative fixtures must catch registry cardinality 21, omitted geometric/visibility, duplicate source ordinal, an attempted GALG-020/GALG-021 renumber, and a 22-row registry whose semantic crosswalk is still wrong.
acceptance_criteria: Every registry collection has a declared and enforced record schema or explicitly versioned union; all typed references including prose-valued references resolve; capability/open-question/risk/operation-cost shapes are normalized or intentionally versioned; exactly one dependency-policy source is authoritative with generated/parity-checked mirrors; negative fixtures prove each defect is detected. The graph-algorithm registry also represents all 22 source families without renumbering published GALG-020/GALG-021: geometric/visibility receives a new stable ID, source ordinals are explicit, traceability is updated, and count/omission/renumber/crosswalk negative fixtures fail closed.

Also preserve the separate prohibition on linked/in-process OpenCV, COLMAP, Ceres, libav/FFmpeg, PyTorch, CUDA and vendor SDKs; an exact bounded external oracle/sidecar is a distinct registered class, not an exception to production linking. title: WP-000/N06.10: Freeze executable test manifest, staged E2E closure, and diagnostic receipt contract
description:
## Background

The current Bead set correctly gives every work package a V04 verification stage and requires unit, property, differential, adversarial, fault, migration, public-path E2E, and detailed diagnostic evidence. It does not yet freeze executable artifact names or distinguish two different meanings of E2E:

1. a package-local end-to-end path through the package public API/reference harness, which must be executable when that package qualifies; and
2. a product-public replay through the eleven-operation Agent Turn Packet waist, CLI/NDJSON/MCP/cockpit projections, which cannot exist for early packages until WP-026/WP-033/WP-034 and the appropriate vertical slice qualify.

Requiring the second form from an early package would introduce a backward dependency and can make the normative DAG impossible. Treating it as merely optional creates false-green qualification and loses the user journey. This task freezes a versioned executable test manifest and staged replay ledger so both obligations remain exact, visible, and eventually closed.

The user outcome is straightforward: a developer or cold operating agent can identify the exact command for any requirement, run the smallest sufficient deterministic proof, obtain a high-signal receipt, understand a failure without source archaeology, and know whether a package is locally correct, publicly reachable, or still awaiting a later composition gate.

## Technical Approach

1. Add a canonical machine registry such as registries/test_artifacts.toml and versioned schemas fdgr.test_manifest/1, fdgr.test_event/1, fdgr.test_receipt/1, and fdgr.deferred_replay/1. The normative naming may change by ADR, but there must be exactly one authority and generated mirrors only.
2. Create one manifest row for every WP-000..WP-047 V04 task, every TEST-001..TEST-044 family, every GATE/SLO/QL predicate, and every FDGR-VS-00..FDGR-VS-06 scenario. A row binds stable case/suite ID, owner Bead and crate(s), semantic requirement, exact fixture roots/privacy class, prerequisites, determinism class, resource bounds, positive/negative/property/metamorphic/differential/fault/migration cases, runner paths, public projection, expected terminal predicate, receipt schema, and retention policy.
3. Freeze executable paths for each work package using a registry-derived lower-snake-case slug:
   - scripts/test/wp_NNN_<slug>.sh is the deterministic suite runner and enumerates every in-crate unit/property test it invokes;
   - scripts/fault/wp_NNN_<slug>.sh runs kill-point, cancellation, malformed-input, pressure and recovery campaigns that apply to the package;
   - scripts/e2e/wp_NNN_<slug>.sh runs the package-local full path and, when its public prerequisites exist, the product-public Agent Turn Packet replay;
   - owning-crate test modules and fixtures are explicit manifest entries rather than an ambiguous owning-crate placeholder.
4. All runners share a strict interface: --case, --seed, --schedule, --fixture-root, --profile, --offline, --receipt-dir, --keep-repro, and --format. Unknown flags or schema versions fail closed. Network is disabled unless an exact authorized test profile says otherwise. Private fixtures and secrets never enter command lines, stdout, support bundles, or public receipts.
5. A package-local E2E is mandatory before Q05 and traverses real package boundaries: reserve/materialize/verify/publish where relevant, success and typed refusal, cancellation/drain/reconcile, restart/resume, and readback/semantic terminal proof. Pure scalar packages use the reference harness and cross-crate codec/evidence boundary; they do not invent asynchronous cancellation inside scalar kernels.
6. If the product-public waist is unavailable, V04 must still create a sealed deferred replay containing exact inputs, expected Agent Turn Packet fields/transitions, capability/why-unavailable state, required future WP/gate, invalidators, and closure owner. Its state is deferred_by_dependency, not pass, skip, or not-applicable. An early V04 does not gain a dependency on the future public package.
7. WP-026/WP-033/WP-034, WP-043, WP-044 and FDGR-VS-01..06 consume all eligible deferred replays. A later qualification or release fails if a replay whose prerequisites are satisfied remains deferred, if an obsolete basis is replayed without migration, or if a public capability lacks an originating package scenario.
8. not_applicable requires a typed rationale and validator-approved semantic class; it cannot be used for inconvenience, absent implementation, unsupported hardware that the gate requires, or a failed case. blocked, failed, indeterminate, unrun, unsupported, and passed remain distinct.
9. Events are stable, bounded NDJSON with monotonic event sequence and virtual/recorded time where applicable. Each event includes schema, suite/case/attempt, seed/schedule, anchor/basis and all input roots, source/tree/closure/toolchain/lock/model/license/policy/schema roots, host/hardware/profile, privacy class, lifecycle transition, budget/pressure/timing, output/artifact/log digests, coverage/omissions/counterevidence, cancellation/drain/descendants, recovery/reconciliation, expected versus observed state, and verdict. Human text is supplemental and cannot be the only diagnostic.
10. Receipts summarize all cases without hiding negative evidence: pass/fail/blocked/indeterminate/unrun counts by required dimension, minimized-repro roots, deferred replay IDs, semantic-equivalence result, public-projection status, terminal gate predicate and signature/checksum as required. Stable ordering and canonical encoding make reruns diffable.
11. Add validators for unique ownership, exact paths, path collisions, dangling TEST/GATE/SLO/QL/WP IDs, forbidden future-package edges, missing negative cases, absent log fields, privacy leaks, stale deferrals, capability overclaims, and manifest/Bead drift. Mutation fixtures delete or corrupt one of each and require stable path-aware diagnostics.
12. Preserve execution efficiency: one runtime-selected binary/runner may serve many cases, fixtures are content-addressed, expensive cases are profile-gated, deterministic shards have explicit merge ordering, failure minimization is bounded, and resumable runs never mix attempts or reuse evidence across incompatible roots.

## Success Criteria

Every verification Bead names real executable artifacts before implementation begins. A package can qualify locally without depending on a later presentation package, yet no intended public user journey disappears: it is captured as a sealed replay and later executed at the earliest valid composition gate. A cold agent can start from a Bead or TEST/GATE/SLO/QL ID, discover one exact runner and fixture set, interpret its machine receipt, reproduce a failure, and select the minimum-cost safe next test without reading plan Markdown or source.

The manifest is complete, deterministic, acyclic, privacy-safe, and bidirectionally traceable. No pass can mean skipped, no process exit can mean semantic completion, no aggregate can hide a required failed/unrun dimension, and no hosted badge can substitute for the local receipt.

## Test Plan

Create scripts/check_test_artifact_manifest.py with unit and property fixtures for all record variants, path normalization/collision, tagged states, dependency closure, stable ordering, receipt completeness and forward/reverse traceability. Negative fixtures cover missing runner, dangling ID, duplicate owner/path, future dependency, invalid not-applicable, pass-with-unrun-required-case, stale deferred replay, missing root/log field, leaked secret/private path, noncanonical vocabulary, mixed attempts, and public capability without replay closure.

Create scripts/e2e/test_manifest_and_deferred_replay_lifecycle.sh. It qualifies an early package through its local harness, proves that the public scenario is sealed rather than falsely passed, introduces the minimum public prerequisites, replays through CLI/NDJSON and the Agent Turn Packet, injects cancellation/crash/stale-basis/privacy/indeterminate failures, resumes with the exact continuation, and closes the replay only after semantic terminal proof. Logs retain every root, state transition, case verdict, omission, deferred/closure owner, minimized repro, timing/budget, output digest and final gate result.

Unit/property tests also prove machine receipts are byte-stable under identical deterministic inputs, redaction is monotone, event ordering is canonical, unknown fields/versions fail closed, and bounded truncation preserves all mandatory authority/safety/recovery fields.

## Considerations

Do not create 48 bespoke harness protocols; create one strict manifest and runner contract with domain-specific cases. Do not centralize pure unit tests away from owning crates; the manifest enumerates them while the suite runner composes them. Do not make early packages depend on WP-026 or later solely for E2E terminology. Conversely, do not let a deferred product replay become permanent debt: exact eligibility, owner, expiry/staleness and release-blocking closure rules are mandatory.

## Acceptance Criteria

Every WP-000..WP-047 and FDGR-VS-00..06 has a validated manifest row and exact executable runner paths; every TEST/GATE/SLO/QL requirement has one or more explicit owners and no orphan. All 48 V04 Beads retain their direct blocking dependency on this contract. Local harness E2E is mandatory at package qualification; unavailable public replay is sealed with exact dependency and closure owner, then becomes release-blocking as soon as eligible. Complete positive, negative, mutation and lifecycle tests prove deterministic receipts, privacy-safe logging, no false-green skip/pass, no future-package dependency cycle and no stale deferred replay.
acceptance_criteria: Every WP-000..WP-047 and every FDGR-VS scenario has a validated executable manifest with exact unit/property/differential/fault/migration/local-harness/public-E2E entrypoints, owner crates, fixtures, prerequisites, TEST/GATE/SLO/QL mappings, structured receipt schema, positive and negative cases, and an honest executable/deferred/not-applicable state. All 48 V04 Beads depend on this contract. Early-package qualification requires real package-local E2E and a sealed deferred public replay without depending on future packages; later public-waist and vertical-slice gates execute and close every deferred replay. Validators reject missing paths, false-green skips, cycles, stale deferrals, receipt/log omissions, and unowned TEST families.

title: WP-000/N06.2: Canonicalize public wire examples and normative continuity prose
description:
## Background

INV-051, ADR-0011, AGENTS.md, and TEST-043 require one registry-derived lower_snake_case public vocabulary and fdgr.<name>/1 payload schema identities. The comprehensive plan still contains a normative measurement JSON example with schema fdgr.measurement.v1 and fields anchorRoot, assetId, and interval95. It also contains a malformed continuity paragraph in which the sentence defining canonical anchor-vector reuse was inserted between “why” and “it cannot.” A future implementer copying either passage would violate the constitutional contract or misread gap/reset behavior.

## Technical Approach

Inventory all JSON/JSONL/NDJSON/MCP/CLI/receipt/event examples and pseudo-structures in normative Markdown, schemas, fixtures, robot docs, help text, and generated traceability. Replace emitting examples with the canonical registry vocabulary; preserve old spellings only as explicitly registered ingress-only aliases with an epoch, deprecation behavior, collision policy, telemetry, and fail-closed removal plan. Correct the continuity prose so one compatible anchor vector or an explicit gap/reset reason is unambiguous.

Make documentation examples executable fixtures where practical: extract/parse JSON blocks, validate payload schema identity and fields, and compare public CLI, MCP, NDJSON, cockpit, receipt, and self-description projections for semantic equivalence. Distinguish a JSON Schema document's HTTPS $id from the payload's schema field so the rule is precise rather than over-broad.

## Acceptance Criteria

The measurement example and every other public payload example use lower_snake_case and fdgr.<name>/1. The continuity paragraph clearly states that each packet binds one complete compatible canonical anchor vector and digest, or returns a typed continuity state/recovery explaining why it cannot. No public emitter produces legacy aliases. Ingress aliases, if retained, are registered, version-bounded, ambiguity-safe, tested, and omitted from normal self-description except migration guidance. TEST-043 and TEST-044 cover the corrected examples and all public surfaces.

## Test Plan

Create scripts/test_document_examples.py with a documentation-example scanner and golden vectors. Fail on camelCase public keys, .v1 payload schema strings, noncanonical enums, an undocumented alias, multiple reduced anchor shapes, or example/schema drift. Exercise old-alias ingress, canonical re-emission, alias collision, expiry, gap/reset/stale/indeterminate continuity, and mixed-generation rejection. title: WP-000/N06.3: Register native codec and inference production-maturity stages
description:
## Background

FRANKENSTACK_DEEP_DIVE constitutional decisions CD-02, CD-03, CD-21, and CD-22 define a closed-world pure-Rust shipping trust domain. Its media strategy requires: owned bounded container/NAL/timestamp parsing; FFmpeg only as an external qualification/bootstrap reference; native safe-Rust H.264/H.265 decode profiles for production maturity; optional hardware decode through an admitted safe process/profile with bitstream and decoded-frame differential evidence; and exact decode-recipe/color-pipeline identity. Its model strategy permits initial Python/PyTorch research sidecars but targets admitted operators/checkpoints in owned safe-Rust tensor/inference infrastructure with exact preprocessing, numeric/operator conformance, bounded memory/cancellation, scalar references, safe portable SIMD, model-space identity, differential fixtures, and license/use profiles.

The current WP-006 and WP-015 beads thoroughly specify supervised sidecars, while the current work-package registry and dependency allowlist can be read as making those sidecars permanent production foundations. No bead owns the native transition or oracle-retirement gate. That omission would lose a stated feature and create an ambiguous release definition.

## Technical Approach

Amend the normative work-package graph to add explicit late native-media and native-inference contract, implementation, differential-verification, migration/fallback, and qualification ownership. Split packages only where codec and inference establish distinct trust, dependency, numeric, resource, license, failure, or verification boundaries. Preserve WP-006 and WP-015 as useful reference/research/bootstrap oracle paths; do not delete them or make early model-free slices wait for late native maturity.

For media, specify admitted container/NAL/color/timestamp profiles, bounds, malformed-input behavior, deterministic frame identity, conformance envelopes, software fallback, optional hardware-process equivalence, cancellation/drain, and platform capability advertising. For inference, specify exact artifact/preprocess/operator/numeric/runtime identities, supported operator closure, scalar and SIMD equivalence, resource/cancellation limits, checkpoint/license admission, model-space generations, proposal-only outputs, and fallback/refusal. Retain external implementations as quarantined differential oracles with no command authority and no unvalidated output publication.

Define which release profiles require native maturity and which honest research/degraded profiles may use an external oracle. Update gates, TEST families, SLOs, dependency/source closure, qualification lanes, public maturity, migration, and IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.

## Acceptance Criteria

The work graph has explicit owners and dependencies for native safe-Rust H.264/H.265 production profiles and owned safe-Rust inference profiles. “Production maturity,” “research,” “bootstrap,” “reference oracle,” “hardware-accelerated,” and “degraded/no-model” have non-overlapping machine statuses and terminal predicates. Native paths retain deterministic reference and external differential oracles; equivalence does not grant model or geometry authority. Early exact-import/reference-geometry slices remain possible without learned models, while any release profile advertising native decode/inference has current local receipts for every admitted platform/artifact/operator/profile.

No C/C++ FFI, in-process Python, unsafe Rust, second runtime, unpinned weight, network download, or opaque GPU/vendor SDK enters the production process.

## Test Plan

Create scripts/e2e/native_media_inference_maturity.sh as the cross-profile public qualification lane. Media evidence covers bounded parser/NAL/timestamp fixtures, H.264/H.265 profile conformance, malformed and adversarial streams, color/range/chroma/rotation/crop identity, frame/timeline differential checks against the external oracle, optional hardware mismatch/refusal, cancellation/crash/descendant drain, and deterministic publication. Inference evidence covers every admitted operator and preprocessing transform, dtype/shape/range/NaN/huge-output rejection, scalar-versus-SIMD and native-versus-source differential envelopes, memory/time cancellation, checkpoint/license substitution, offline operation, model-space generation migration, fallback/refusal, and proposal-only semantic gates. Local receipts retain source/toolchain/artifact/license/hardware/profile/input/output roots and negative evidence.

## Considerations

Do not implement a custom codec or Rust GPU stack merely to satisfy ideology. The normative stage is required; implementation proceeds only after bounded profiles and evidence justify it. If a platform cannot earn native maturity, narrow its release claim explicitly. External oracles remain valuable for differential testing but cannot silently define shipping semantics forever.

title: WP-000/N06.4: Reconcile camera, gimbal, and assisted-flight authority scope
description:
## Background

The initial constitution is clear: operate only authorized devices/accounts, begin read-only, never bypass pairing/authentication/encryption/access/geographic controls, expose no arbitrary packet injection or flight commands, and treat CAP-DEVICE-CONTROL as reserved_unadmitted. NONGOAL-001 requires a separate flight-safety architecture before sending flight-control commands. Yet the deep-dive's “correct integration order” later says to add one reversible camera/gimbal effect family with full obligation semantics and then assisted flight after simulator, physical, capability, and human-preemption gates. No current WP explicitly reconciles whether these are FDGR roadmap targets, deferred research, or out-of-scope successors.

## Technical Approach

Make the scope decision explicit in doctrine, capabilities, effects, work packages, gates, tests, SLOs, security/privacy/device profiles, and public maturity. Separate passive observation, authority-free human pilot guidance, camera media/settings effects, gimbal orientation effects, vehicle flight control, emergency stop/preemption, and arbitrary/raw vendor packets. Do not call a physical effect “reversible” merely because a compensating command may exist; record real-world irreversibility, unknown outcome, and safety consequences.

If camera/gimbal effects stay in the roadmap, create a distinct later authority/trust/failure/verification package after passive live qualification with sealed intents/plans, exact device/profile epoch, scoped capability, idempotency, lease/fence, final preconditions, dispatch/acceptance/observed/verified/terminal states, cancellation/drain/reconciliation, operator presence, safe bounds, and no raw-command escape hatch. If assisted flight remains a target, require a separate adopted flight-safety architecture, regulatory/profile analysis, simulator and bounded physical qualification, collision/geofence model, human override/preemption, fail-safe loss-of-link behavior, and independent release claim. Otherwise register both as deferred/out-of-scope with no misleading affordance. Under the current governing AGENTS.md prohibition, no camera, gimbal, or aircraft command implementation bead may begin; a future roadmap target requires an explicit constitutional amendment before its package can become executable.

## Acceptance Criteria

Initial VS-01..VS-04 and every initial advertised profile remain manual-pilot/read-only at the aircraft-control boundary. Pilot cards distinguish recommendation, acknowledgement/refusal, observed maneuver, usable evidence, and question resolution. Device self-description reports control unavailable unless a separately registered later gate has positive evidence. Camera/gimbal and assisted-flight scope is explicit, dependency-ordered, non-bypassable, and does not weaken owner authorization, vendor controls, privacy, safety, or effect reconciliation. Under the current governing AGENTS.md, command-capable camera, gimbal, and aircraft effects remain unadmitted and no implementation bead may start without an explicit constitutional amendment. No arbitrary packet, shell, vendor command, or generic control surface is ever exposed.

## Test Plan

Create scripts/e2e/device_authority_refusal.sh for the initial public refusal boundary. Negative tests prove read-only profiles cannot mint control tickets, textual/model recommendations cannot dispatch, unsupported profiles return typed unavailable reasons, and raw packet/command attempts are rejected. If a later effect family is admitted, run deterministic protocol fixtures plus simulator and bounded physical campaigns for stale profile/plan/fence, duplicate/reordered/lost commands, disconnect, timeout, cancellation, crash, unknown outcome, operator refusal, safety preemption, geofence/collision constraints, compensating action failure, observation mismatch, and terminal reconciliation. Logs retain device/controller/app/firmware/OS/region, authorization, plan/capability/fence/idempotency identities, state transitions, observations, human actions, and terminal proof.

## Considerations

Owner authorization is necessary but not sufficient. A camera shutter or gimbal move can still be consequential and cannot be modeled as a ledger-only mutation. This bead must not normalize autonomous flight into the initial project by terminology; either establish the separate safety architecture or keep the capability unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Initial releases remain read-only/manual-pilot and expose no arbitrary packet or flight command; any later camera/gimbal effect or assisted-flight capability is either explicitly deferred/out of scope or placed behind a separate normative safety architecture with typed authority, simulation/physical/human-preemption qualification, obligations, and honest capability status. Under the current AGENTS.md, all command-capable device effects remain unadmitted; a future implementation requires an explicit governing-constitution amendment before any code task is unblocked.

title: WP-000/N06.5: Freeze CD-01..CD-32 and the 21-step integration-order traceability
description:
## Background

The deep dive states that its 32 constitutional decisions override weaker language until the comprehensive plan is trued up, but the current Bead corpus has no exact CD-01..CD-32 identifiers and therefore cannot prove complete ownership without reopening that Markdown. The same document gives a normative 21-step integration order whose late native codec/inference, ATP/RaptorQ custody, camera/gimbal, and assisted-flight stages are only partially represented in the current WP graph. A mapping comment saying the document was “absorbed” is insufficient evidence of feature-complete translation.

## Technical Approach

Create a generated, machine-checkable traceability matrix and matching Bead ownership for these exact constitutional decisions:

1. CD-01 one Asupersync runtime and explicit context; 2. CD-02 pure-Rust shipping trust domain; 3. CD-03 closed exact dependency universe; 4. CD-04 immutable highest-authority originals; 5. CD-05 one evidence universe; 6. CD-06 coherent pinned reader versions; 7. CD-07 geometry as identified constraint system; 8. CD-08 first-class competing hypotheses; 9. CD-09 metric scale as proof; 10. CD-10 witnessed negative reads; 11. CD-11 reserve/materialize/validate-or-verify/root-last publish (the canonical FDGR stage name is verify); 12. CD-12 rebuildable derived generations; 13. CD-13 incremental reconstruction with full oracle; 14. CD-14 certificate-bearing graph projections; 15. CD-15 deterministic nonunique choices; 16. CD-16 device/cloud effects distinct from ledger commits; 17. CD-17 witnessed/idempotent/fenced consequential effects; 18. CD-18 cognition has no command path; 19. CD-19 ATP moves immutable graphs, never authority; 20. CD-20 adaptivity subordinate to invariants; 21. CD-21 models are untrusted proposals; 22. CD-22 reference before optimization; 23. CD-23 advisory one-way agent memory; 24. CD-24 local qualification is release authority; 25. CD-25 one agent operating loop; 26. CD-26 questions are proof obligations; 27. CD-27 one Agent Turn Packet on every result; 28. CD-28 self-explaining context compression/Pack DNA; 29. CD-29 one-basis alternatives and Pareto frontier; 30. CD-30 surprise-driven replay/shadow/canary/rollback accretion; 31. CD-31 handoff preserves understanding, never authority; 32. CD-32 qualification-backed self-description.

Encode this exact integration order as dependency-closure assertions: (1) freeze identities/encodings/anchors/outcomes/publication/agent constitution; (2) deterministic evidence/custody and cold-agent oracles; (3) synthetic exact-ground-truth generators; (4) Asupersync regions/budgets/lab; (5) exact import and byte-preserving live spool; (6) clock/calibration/track/pose references and branches; (7) graph views/reference certificates; (8) Atlas reference spatial blocks/root publication; (9) full-recompute then incremental depth/fusion/topology; (10) progressive search/context/semantic proposal-resolution; (11) objective/question coverage and manual next-best-view guidance; (12) passive DJI live qualification; (13) separately gated camera/gimbal effects; (14) one-at-a-time Franken adapters behind reference semantics; (15) frontiers/watch/reconcile/handoff/multi-agent; (16) episode/surprise and shadow/canary before adaptation; (17) native codec/inference with retained external oracles; (18) ATP/RaptorQ multi-provider custody/restore; (19) assisted flight only after safety gates; (20) optimize only from local receipts; (21) release only from clean local Doodlestein source closure and agent scenarios.

For each row, record owner WP/task, prerequisites, gates, TEST/SLO/qualification lanes, evidence boundary, public maturity, and at least one negative fixture. Reconcile this order with FDGR-VS-00 and the six vertical slices so early slices contain no future-stage dependency and late stages are not lost.

## Acceptance Criteria

All 53 rows (32 decisions plus 21 ordered stages) resolve to existing or newly registered normative IDs and Beads. The matrix has no dangling owner, gate, test, or dependency; deterministic generation is stable; reverse traceability shows no orphan WP/gate/capability; and a closure checker proves each stage includes every earlier mandatory contract while excluding unneeded later capabilities. ATP/RaptorQ is explicitly owned as content-addressed object-graph transfer/repair, never command or credential transport. External codec/model oracles, camera/gimbal, and assisted flight have honest maturity and gates. FDGR-VS-00 incorporates any necessary WP graph correction without erasing later features.

## Test Plan

Create scripts/check_constitutional_traceability.py plus positive and negative traceability fixtures. Fail when a CD/stage is absent, mapped only to prose, assigned to an invalid ID, missing a terminal gate/test, ordered before a hard predecessor, or pulled transitively into an earlier vertical slice. ## Considerations

Traceability is useful only when it guards real capability and evidence; do not create ceremonial duplicate documents. The generated matrix should point to the single normative contract and executable evidence. Where the current WP graph contradicts this order, change the normative graph rather than adding bypass edges in Beads.

title: WP-000/N06.6: Freeze canonical public state axes, profiles, and operation vocabulary
description:
## Background

The full-document audit found multiple public vocabularies that describe the same or adjacent concepts without an explicit crosswalk. This is dangerous for agents and implementers because an enum can appear compatible while silently collapsing authority, epistemic status, lifecycle, or retry safety.

The conflicts are concrete:

- architecture/SEMANTICS_MANIFEST.md uses observed, certified_derived, inferred, predicted, assumed, stale, unknown, contradicted, and indeterminate, while the Agent Operating Model distinguishes raw_observed, normalized_observed, certified_derived, model_proposed, inferred, predicted, assumed, stale, unknown, contradicted, and indeterminate.
- The semantic disposition lattice Observation | Hypothesis | Resolved | Rejected | Indeterminate coexists with the geometry/claim authority ladder Proposal -> Corroborated -> ResolvedRelative -> ResolvedMetricEstimated -> ResolvedMetricWitnessed -> Surveyed and orthogonal modifiers such as Contradicted, Occluded, CoverageInsufficient, Retracted, and Indeterminate. These are distinct axes and must not be flattened.
- architecture/QUESTION_OBJECTIVE_GRAPH.md defines unopened, open, partially_answered, answered, contradicted, blocked, stale, indeterminate, and retired; the Agent Operating Model instead shows open -> investigating -> answer_proposed -> resolved | rejected | indeterminate | suspended.
- The canonical response statuses are complete, partial, accepted, blocked, failed, cancelled, and indeterminate, while obligation, effect, process, publication, and objective completion each have more detailed internal states. Transport success must not alias any of them.
- resume_continuation appears in the Agent Operating Model recovery list but is absent from the narrower protocol/recovery lists.
- Profile bounds disagree: pulse is 150-400 tokens in prose but 120-400 in the registry; briefing is 500-1500 in prose but 500-1600 in the registry.
- The Dwarf Fortress transfer document exposes an older thirteen-operation surface (discover, observe, plan_capture, wait, export, checkpoint, and restore included), while the constitutional public waist is exactly eleven operations: fdgr.open_session, orient, query, propose, compare, commit, watch, cancel, explain, handoff, and doctor.
- Publication prose alternates between reserve -> materialize -> validate -> publish and the constitutional FDGR vocabulary reserve -> materialize -> verify -> publish; examples also contain retired camelCase and .v1 payload forms.

These are planning blockers. An implementation must not choose a spelling or merge axes ad hoc.

## Technical Approach

After WP-000/N06.1 establishes authoritative registry schemas, freeze one machine-owned vocabulary and explicit crosswalks:

1. Register the canonical epistemic derivation/authority axis, claim disposition axis, quantitative uncertainty structure, scale-authority ladder, contradiction/staleness/retraction modifiers, and eligibility rules for satisfying mutation preconditions.
2. Register one question lifecycle with terminal predicates, coverage/detectability requirements, stale/blocked/suspended semantics, and lossless mappings from both documented draft vocabularies.
3. Register response status, obligation lifecycle, effect lifecycle, publication/durability state, objective state, compatibility state, and process outcome as separate typed axes. State which combinations are legal and which transitions require evidence.
4. Reconcile the recovery registry, including whether resume_continuation is a canonical class or a typed action under an existing class. Preserve blind-retry refusal for indeterminate effects.
5. Make registries/agent_profiles.toml the single source for token/byte targets and hard mandatory fields. Resolve the pulse and briefing bound conflicts; generated docs, examples, schemas, and tests consume that source.
6. Retire the old thirteen-operation vocabulary by mapping every legitimate domain verb to the eleven semantic operations. discover and observe become read projections; plan_capture becomes propose; wait becomes watch; export, checkpoint, and restore compile through propose -> commit -> watch. No legacy alias may bypass planning or commit.
7. Freeze verify as the FDGR publication-stage term unless an ADR proves a separate validation stage is semantically necessary. If both exist, define their exact ordering and evidence boundary rather than using them interchangeably.
8. Enforce lower snake_case public names and fdgr.<name>/1 schema identities; aliases are ingress-only under a versioned migration epoch and are never emitted.
9. Update affected schemas, ADRs, generated help/robot docs, work packages, traceability, and IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md together. Preserve historical source spellings only as provenance or migration fixtures.

## Acceptance Criteria

Every public enum/value has one registered identity, owner, axis, definition, legal predecessors/successors, evidence requirement, authority implication, and terminal/recovery behavior. The two epistemic vocabularies, two question lifecycles, recovery mismatch, profile-bound discrepancies, old operation surface, and publication-stage wording are resolved without losing a distinction.

A cold agent sees one stable vocabulary across CLI JSON, NDJSON, MCP, Agent Turn Packets, receipts, context packs, model-worker messages, generated docs, and examples. Domain sugar cannot create a twelfth operation or combine proposal and dispatch. Unknown or legacy values fail closed or enter only through an explicit migration profile.

## Test Plan

Create scripts/test_public_state_vocabularies.py and scripts/e2e/state_axis_roundtrip.sh.

The unit/property suite must enumerate every registered axis and legal transition; reject cross-axis substitution, impossible jumps, unknown variants, dangerous defaults, noncanonical emitted aliases, contradictory terminal states, and profiles whose generated bounds differ from the registry. Golden tests cover every mapping from the retired question, epistemic, recovery, and operation vocabularies. Mutation fixtures delete a variant, swap two axes, reintroduce a thirteen-operation escape hatch, change a profile bound in prose only, or emit .v1/camelCase and must fail with file/record/field diagnostics.

The E2E script drives representative success, partial, blocked, cancellation, indeterminate, continuation-resume, claim-resolution, question-retirement, and publication transitions through CLI, MCP, and NDJSON projections. Logs retain source/registry/schema roots, operation and state IDs, before/after axes, evidence and recovery, output digests, and terminal verdict.

## Considerations

Do not reduce complexity by merging genuinely orthogonal concepts. Epistemic class is not confidence; disposition is not authority; transport acceptance is not effect observation; publication is not objective completion; cancellation requested is not terminal cancellation. The goal is a singular vocabulary with explicit axes, not one giant enum.
acceptance_criteria: One registry-derived contract defines every public state axis, profile bound, recovery class, publication verb, and operation mapping; all legacy vocabularies have explicit lossless migrations or retirement decisions, and positive, negative, round-trip, and cross-surface tests prove no semantic collapse or ambiguous emission.

title: WP-000/N06.7: Register cross-plane maturity ladders and proof-state machines
description:
## Background

Several load-bearing maturity and effect state machines exist only in prose. They are not redundant: each answers a different question about evidence custody, adapter compatibility, external effects, and readiness. Without registered identities and transition rules, an implementation can skip stages, treat a negative test as success-path proof, or advertise a high-risk surface because a lower layer happened to work.

The document corpus requires all of the following:

- DJI/source maturity D0 exact original-media import; D1 controller/phone/display capture ingest; D2 passive owner-network/USB discovery and packet recording; D3 authenticated live video using legitimate paired state; D4 typed telemetry and clock correlation; D5 camera setting/recording observation or bounded effect; D6 gimbal observation or bounded effect; D7 manual next-view guidance with no flight command; D8 assisted waypoint/flight effects; D9 autonomous mission profile under a separate future approval.
- Adapter compatibility promotion Observed -> Hypothesized -> ParserFixtureQualified -> EmulatorQualified -> PassivePhysicalQualified -> EffectPhysicalQualified -> Recovery/CompatibilityQualified -> Promoted.
- Live-spool custody Reserved -> Receiving -> SealedPayload -> Indexed -> RootReferenced -> Durable -> Replicated, with partial segments retained as explicit truncated evidence.
- Custody grades LocalStaged, LocalDurable, ReplicaReceiptOnly, ReplicaReadbackVerified, MultiFailureDomainVerified, RepairQualified, and RestoreCampaignQualified.
- Publication durability distinguishes staged, visible, and durable; visible can exceed durable only when the API and receipt say so.
- Consequential effects distinguish prepared/local commit, dispatch-attempt persistence, dispatch, transport acceptance, device/provider acceptance, observed effect, verified output, root publication, terminal predicate, objective progress, and stable completion. Loss between stages may be indeterminate.
- Search/index activation distinguishes build, segment seal, count/producer/source verification, root publication, activation, and retirement of the prior unpinned generation.
- Model admission separately proves artifact/license, bounded offline execution, contract/numeric/coordinate validity, reproducibility, domain behavior, geometry, semantics, economics, fallback, and release compatibility.
- Release evidence separately retains source closure, toolchain, dependency policy, qualification lanes, artifact builds, packaging, installer smoke, performance, promotion manifest, public upload, and post-upload readback.

The current registry snapshots do not provide a single transition contract for these prose-only ladders, and WP-000/N06.3 and N06.4 need those contracts to define honest production and device scope.

## Technical Approach

After WP-000/N06.1 establishes registry record authority and WP-000/N06.6 freezes the canonical public state axes, register every ladder as its own typed axis with stable lower snake_case values, explicit current maturity, legal transitions, evidence predicates, demotion/rollback rules, and public projection.

1. Preserve D0-D9 exactly. Under the current AGENTS constitution, D0-D4 and D7 are potential read/advice scopes. D5 camera and D6 gimbal must be decomposed into observational and effect subcapabilities: read-only observations may be admitted under CAP-DEVICE-OBSERVE after profile qualification, while recording/settings/gimbal mutations remain unavailable until separate constitutional, capability, safety, physical, reconciliation, and human-preemption gates are admitted. D8-D9 remain unavailable future effect scopes. No packet discovery or observation promotes an effect.
2. Bind each adapter profile to exact aircraft/controller/app/firmware/OS/region/pairing/media/transport/grammar/adapter/schema identity. Unknown differences fail down to a proven lower capability and fence prepared effects.
3. Treat emulator success, passive physical success, effect success, recovery success, and profile promotion as separate positive receipts. A malformed-input rejection proves only the rejected case.
4. Make spool, object, root, custody, restore, and retention transitions monotone where required. Define restart adoption, quarantine, repair, successor epoch, and last-original deletion rules.
5. Register provider and device effect stages so local request durability, process acceptance, transport/device/provider acknowledgment, authoritative observation, verification, publication, terminal proof, objective completion, and stable completion can never alias.
6. Register model and media worker maturity together with WP-000/N06.3: external oracle, reference differential, bootstrap/research lane, native candidate, native differential-qualified, production-admitted, degraded, and retired/permanent-exception are explicit; native byte/numeric equivalence never grants semantic authority.
7. Register release maturity: static design validation, native host qualification, required lane closure, artifact/installer proof, manifest sealing, publication, and readback. Hosted status and upload success have no promotion authority.
8. Project these axes through Agent Turn Packet system/work ledgers, capability/compatibility manifests, doctor, explain, affordances, and typed recovery. A compact packet may omit low-value history but cannot hide a downgrade, unsafe unavailable surface, indeterminate effect, or custody weakness.

## Acceptance Criteria

Every maturity label and transition above has one owner, current status, predecessor evidence, terminal receipt, failure/demotion path, and public semantics. It is impossible to jump from passive observation to effect authority, from provider receipt to retrievability, from model subprocess success to admitted proposal, from visible to durable by implication, or from build/upload success to release.

WP-000/N06.3 and N06.4 consume these registered axes rather than inventing local status words. Existing D0 exact-import value, D7 manual guidance, external differential oracles, and future D5-D6/D8-D9 targets remain represented; no feature is deleted to resolve the conflict.

## Test Plan

Create scripts/test_maturity_state_machines.py and scripts/e2e/maturity_and_effect_transitions.sh.

Property tests enumerate legal paths, demotions, restarts, and rollbacks and reject skipped gates, cross-axis substitutions, impossible monotonicity, stale profile promotion, negative-only success claims, and dangerous defaults. Deterministic fixtures cover a truncated spool restart, visible-not-durable root, provider receipt without readback, repair without byte identity, model process exit with NaN output, emulator-only DJI profile, passive profile attempting D5, lost response after dispatch, restored root requiring a successor epoch, partial Doodlestein run, upload without public readback, and deletion of the last original.

The E2E script exposes every representative transition through orient/query/propose/commit/watch/doctor/explain. Logs retain exact source/profile/model/provider/policy roots, prior and successor state, evidence IDs, dispatch/observation/verification/publication stages, capabilities/fences, recovery, output digests, and terminal verdict.

## Considerations

These ladders should share a registry framework but must remain distinct dimensions. A system can be ParserFixtureQualified but not PassivePhysicalQualified; LocalDurable but not ReplicaReadbackVerified; production-admitted as a codec but still authority-free as a semantic producer. Do not collapse them into one readiness percentage.
acceptance_criteria: All device, compatibility, spool, custody, publication, effect, model-worker, and release maturity ladders are separately registered with legal transitions, evidence and demotion rules, current truthful status, and agent-visible tests that reject every skipped or conflated proof stage.
