title: WP-000/N06.9.7: Import the complete FrankenGraphDB unified-evidence graph model
description:
## Background

The GraphDB transfer composes evidence, scene, provenance, question, objective, work, custody, and claim graphs in one version universe while keeping authority and immutable roots explicit. Twelve bets and six named mechanisms must be disambiguated from other FDGR aliases.

## Technical Approach

1. **One evidence universe:** every node, edge, view, and query names the same project/evidence/scene/schema/policy roots; cross-generation joins cannot happen accidentally. Chronicle is the immutable capsule and root-publication analogue.
2. **Atlas spatial LSM-MVCC:** spatial, temporal, and evidence keys use immutable runs and snapshot visibility, temperature tiers, representation-specific blocks, measured compaction/migration, and exact roots. This Atlas is a qualified mechanism, not an ambiguous subsystem alias.
3. **Loom factorized and worst-case-aware execution:** represent joins without needless Cartesian materialization; select deterministic plans using bounded cardinality, width, and cost witnesses; preserve reference semantics and explain estimates versus actuals.
4. **Ripple incremental everything:** propagate signed changes and first-class retractions through views, recursive fixed points, claims, questions, coverage, and indexes. Calibration or loop-closure rejection cannot leave hidden stale products.
5. **Beacon one family of indexes over one truth:** lexical, vector, spatial, temporal, property, and adjacency indexes share snapshot and producer roots and remain rebuildable accelerators, never independent truth.
6. **Prism algorithms over zero-copy snapshot views:** graph kernels consume immutable typed views with stable order/ties, cancellation/budgets, certificates, and reference/optimized parity without copying the whole graph or mutating canonical state.
7. **Branches for hypotheses, agents, and experiments:** immutable branches isolate alternate loop closures, scales, identities, plans, and policies; comparison, merge, and rebase retain common basis and counterevidence.
8. **Deterministic plan and result certificates:** query digest, normalized algebra, roots, capability/policy, plan, estimates, actual work, ordering, result digest, omissions, and completeness form a replayable certificate.
9. **Planner-enforced capability security:** authorization/privacy predicates participate in planning and index eligibility, not post-filtering; prohibited data cannot affect ranks, counts, existence, timing summaries, or caches.
10. **Replication and remote reconstruction from immutable roots:** transfer only missing addressed blocks/manifests, verify, reconstruct indexes/views locally, and publish a new small root; provider acknowledgement is not retrievability.
11. **Hybrid retrieval and GraphRAG inside the scene planner:** context subgraphs combine exact lexical, vector, spatial, temporal, provenance, question, and coverage evidence with Pack DNA; summaries remain proposals and cite their exact subgraph.
12. **One process posture, multiple products:** library, CLI, service, MCP, and viewer share one semantic core/schema; topology and presentation never create alternate mutation or authority planes.

Freeze a staged reference-first order: canonical types, codecs, objects, capsules, snapshots; reference graph/algebra; branches/MVCC; deterministic algorithms; indexes/search; incremental retractions; optimizer/certificates; replication; optimized storage; product projections. Reject a graph-shaped cache, mutable current graph, per-product truth stores, nondeterministic optimizer, post-hoc ACL filter, GraphRAG authority, or optimized engine before an oracle.

## Acceptance Criteria

Every bet and mechanism has a unique name, owner, boundary, deterministic reference, admission evidence, and rejected imitation. Queries cannot mix roots or leak unauthorized existence; retractions converge; branches isolate; certificates replay; remote restore reconstructs canonical truth; all product surfaces remain semantically identical.

## Test Plan

Create `scripts/test_unified_graphdb_transfer.py` and `scripts/e2e/graph_branch_retraction_replication.sh`. Differential tests cover algebra, joins, fixed points, factorization, stable plans/ties, snapshot isolation, LSM visibility/compaction, signed retractions, index parity/rebuild, branch compare/merge, capability noninterference, certificates, missing-block replication, and GraphRAG citation/proposal status. Faults include stale roots, skew, cancellation, compaction/activation crash, unauthorized cache, corrupt remote block, partial transfer, recursive retraction, and optimized/reference divergence.

Logs retain graph/snapshot/branch/root/query/plan/index IDs, algebra, estimates/actual work, capabilities/policy, producer roots, deltas/retractions/rounds, ordering/ties, transferred blocks/readback, result/context digests, timings/budgets, omissions/completeness, and verdict.

## Considerations

One universe does not mean one giant crate or mutable database. Split at real dependency, trust, format, failure, or verification seams; the Agent Turn Packet is a projection, not another store.
acceptance_criteria: All twelve FrankenGraphDB bets, Chronicle/Atlas/Loom/Ripple/Beacon/Prism meanings, topology, and reference-first order map to one canonical graph/evidence architecture with deterministic branch, incremental, security, replication, GraphRAG, and certificate tests. The six source mechanisms are Chronicle, Strata, Loom, Ripple, Beacon, and Prism; Strata maps explicitly to the qualified FDGR Atlas analogue without erasing either identity or conflating source mechanism, subsystem, and product-bet namespaces.

title: WP-000/N06.9.8: Import all 22 FrankenNetworkX algorithm families and certificates
description:
## Background

FDGR is a family of typed evidence, geometry, visibility, question, objective, work, custody, provenance, and claim graphs. Saying “graph algorithms” is insufficient: the transfer enumerates 22 families with distinct inputs, numeric domains, determinism, certificates, budgets, and uses.

## Technical Approach

Freeze graph kind, node/edge identity/type, snapshot/basis, weight/capacity/cost/probability units and domains, loop/parallel-edge policy, nonfinite rejection, stable order/ties, result/certificate schema, complexity witness, cancellation points, and unsupported-size outcome. Algorithms consume immutable snapshot views and never hash iteration.

1. **Connected components/dynamic connectivity:** scene islands, constraints, custody, work partitions; component labels plus spanning witnesses.
2. **Articulation points, bridges, biconnectivity, block-cut trees:** fragile geometry, visibility, provenance, or work chokepoints; removal-separation certificate.
3. **Strong components, condensation DAGs, cycle diagnosis:** dependency/effect/claim cycles; SCC membership and representative-cycle certificate.
4. **Topological order, critical path, antichains, scheduling:** WP, obligation, and release DAGs; edge-order and path/slack certificate.
5. **Shortest, widest, minimax, k-shortest paths:** view, transfer, and recovery alternatives under typed distance/risk/bandwidth/uncertainty; exact edge sequence and accumulated cost.
6. **Dominators/post-dominators:** gates every resolution, publication, or recovery path traverses; dominance tree tied to start/terminal.
7. **Minimum spanning forests/tree backbones:** sparse deterministic pose/scene initialization without final-geometry overclaim; selected-edge cut/cycle checks.
8. **Cycle bases/minimum cycle bases:** loop-closure, pose, and custody consistency; canonical cycles, rank, weights, residual bindings.
9. **Max flow/min cut/Gomory-Hu/cut structure:** capacity and bottleneck evidence; nonnegative capacities plus conservation and cut equality.
10. **Min-cost flow/circulation:** capture, compute, transfer, and repair assignment with supplies, capacities, typed costs, feasibility/duality.
11. **Bipartite matching/assignment:** frame-track, observation-object, task-agent, replica-provider associations with stable equal-cost choice and unmatched reasons.
12. **Clique/independent set/coloring/association graphs:** compatible correspondences, conflict-free selections, scheduling, hypotheses; exact or heuristic status with bounds.
13. **k-core/k-truss/degeneracy/dense substructure:** support robustness, claim/landmark communities, pruning; peel-order/core/truss certificate.
14. **Centrality/PageRank/HITS/PPR/attention:** advisory prioritization with normalization, damping, convergence/error, personalization basis, and no authority.
15. **Community detection/cuts/room-scene partition hypotheses:** objective, seed/resolution, stability, uncertainty, and counterevidence; never ontology resolution by score.
16. **Spectral algorithms/early-warning monitors:** Laplacian/eigenstructure with tolerance, symmetry/PSD assumptions, residual, sign/order convention, and reference oracle.
17. **Isomorphism/subgraph matching/repeated motifs:** structural repetition and duplicates; canonical mapping and timeout/unknown distinct from no match.
18. **Edit distance/maximum common subgraphs/change graphs:** physical change versus reinterpretation; typed edit costs/basis and exact or approximate bounds.
19. **Tree decompositions/factor graphs/elimination order:** inference complexity; bags/running intersection or factor/elimination certificate with width/fill.
20. **Geometric/visibility graphs:** frusta, occlusion, line of sight, portals, proximity, adjacency, view planning with explicit frame/units/tolerance/robust predicates.
21. **Submodular selection/diversity:** next views, evidence, or context under budget with assumptions, constraints, marginal-gain trace, approximation claim, and do-nothing option.
22. **Temporal graphs/persistence:** tracks, claims, coverage, work, compatibility, repeated capture under explicit event/valid/system time and interval/version identity.

Define canonical graph serialization/fingerprints and reference-versus-optimized lanes. Optimized results must equal the oracle or a registered semantic equivalence class before performance admission. Unsupported, timeout, budget-exhausted, and indeterminate are not false or empty.

## Acceptance Criteria

Every family has an owner, graph/weight domain, deterministic reference, stable tie policy, result/certificate schema, complexity/memory/cancellation bounds, negative cases, optimized gate, and Agent Turn Packet benefit. All 22 remain represented when planned or deferred; none is advertised from source presence.

## Test Plan

Create `scripts/test_graph_algorithm_portfolio.py` and `scripts/e2e/graph_decision_certificate_suite.sh`. Differential against independent small-graph oracles; property/metamorphic tests for relabeling, union, path/cut/flow duality, matching feasibility, peel/cycle/topological certificates, spectral residual, isomorphism maps, decomposition validity, frame transforms, marginal traces, and temporal windows. Include multigraph/loops, ties, empty/disconnected, negative/overflow/NaN, huge/adversarial, cancellation, timeout, memory budget, dynamic retraction, and optimized divergence.

Logs retain family/schema IDs, graph snapshot/fingerprint/kind/numeric policy, counts/order, parameters/seed/ties, iterations/residuals, complexity/memory budget, certificate/result digest, oracle diff, cancellation/unsupported reason, timings, and verdict.

## Considerations

Not every family ships in the first crate stage, but every use and gate stays visible. Approximate and heuristic outputs remain typed proposals, never semantic authority.
## Registry Migration Constraint Discovered by Fresh-Eyes Audit

Do not mistake this bead’s numbered source inventory for existing registry identity. The current registry has 21 rows and omits geometric/visibility graphs; GALG-020 already means temporal graphs and GALG-021 already means submodular selection. Preserve those published IDs, add a new stable ID for geometric/visibility (default GALG-022), and encode the source ordinals explicitly: tree decomposition 19, geometric/visibility 20, submodular 21, temporal 22. Update the plan traceability index and all owner/test references. Unit/mutation coverage must reject a 21-row registry, omitted family, semantic duplicate, reordered source ordinal without crosswalk, or any repair that renumbers existing IDs.
acceptance_criteria: All 22 graph-algorithm families have explicit FDGR uses, typed graph/numeric semantics, deterministic tie breaks, complexity/cancellation bounds, independently checkable certificates, reference/optimized differential tests, and truthful support status. The canonical registry contains 22 distinct semantic rows, preserves published GALG-020 temporal and GALG-021 submodular identities, adds geometric/visibility under a new stable ID, and validates explicit source-family ordinals and bidirectional traceability.

title: WP-000/N06.9.9: Import all 15 Dwarf Fortress agent-control mechanisms without bypasses
description:
## Background

The Dwarf Fortress MCP transfer concerns control shape, not game code: a partially observed changing world, device/version profiles, semantic intent compiled to unstable lower-level representations, consequential effects, long-running work, and agents that must resume safely. The older thirteen-domain-verb surface is historical; every legitimate action must compile through the canonical eleven FDGR operations.

## Technical Approach

1. **Canonical semantic state above device layout:** agents see stable entities, facts, hypotheses, capabilities, and handles, never raw offsets/packets as durable truth; adapters translate a qualified exact profile.
2. **Owner-authorized profile laboratory:** record aircraft/controller/app/firmware/OS/region/pairing/transport/grammar/schema identity; begin read-only; vary one variable at a time; preserve raw captures; promote only by staged evidence.
3. **Observation capsules and exact anchors:** every observation binds session/turn, evidence/scene/branch roots, device/profile, time/frame/scale/coverage, producer, and epistemic class; stale or mixed anchors fail closed.
4. **Narrow agent waist:** only open_session, orient, query, propose, compare, commit, watch, cancel, explain, handoff, and doctor are top-level operations. discover/observe are query projections; plan_capture is propose; wait is watch; export/checkpoint/restore are proposed, committed, and watched effects.
5. **Semantic intent compilation:** typed high-level intent compiles deterministically to adapter/process steps with sealed manifest, expected evidence gain, costs/budgets, safety/authority predicates, and human-readable preview. Models/recommendations never dispatch.
6. **Witnessed mutation and final device preconditions:** commit rechecks exact profile, pairing, capability, fence/lease, basis, safety, human-preemption, and idempotency immediately before effect. Current constitution permits read-only observation/manual guidance; mutations remain unavailable unless separately admitted.
7. **Effect stages and honest completion:** distinguish prepared, locally committed, dispatch attempted, dispatched, transport accepted, device/provider accepted, observed, verified, published, terminal, objective-progress, and stable-complete states. Lost responses may be indeterminate.
8. **Idempotency, lookup, and retry:** stable request/effect IDs and status lookup precede retry; retry policy depends on effect stage and adapter guarantees; never blindly repeat indeterminate physical/provider effects.
9. **Leases and fencing:** concurrent agents/workers hold bounded leases with monotone fences; stale owners cannot publish or dispatch after expiry/reassignment; crash/restart reconciles authoritative state.
10. **Obligations for long-running work:** accepted work creates visible owner, predicate, progress, heartbeat, deadline/budget, cancellation, recovery, result/publication, and handoff obligations; acceptance is not completion.
11. **Compact token-budgeted observation:** Agent Turn Packet and profiles preserve exact anchors, epistemic/authority posture, active/indeterminate work, uncertainty/coverage, budgets, recovery, and minimum next steps while trimming only low-value history.
12. **Compatibility certification and degraded modes:** ParserFixtureQualified, EmulatorQualified, PassivePhysicalQualified, EffectPhysicalQualified, Recovery/CompatibilityQualified, Promoted. Unknown differences degrade to the proven lower capability and fence effects.
13. **Doctor and sealed repair plans:** doctor observes and diagnoses without mutation; repair is a proposed sealed plan with risk/rollback/preconditions, separately committed and watched; no arbitrary command execution.
14. **Untrusted content and no arbitrary execution:** packet/media/model/report/user strings are data; schemas, allowlists, rooted capabilities, bounded sidecars, and escaping prevent code/command/path injection.
15. **Advisory Eidetic memory outside canonical state:** memories and anti-patterns cite evidence and may influence proposals/context only; they cannot alter device state, claims, capabilities, protocol facts, or retry authority.

Non-bypassability rules: no adapter-only top-level verb, alternate write plane, hidden worker queue, model-direct action, handoff-direct mutation, raw packet injection, implicit pairing/auth bypass, profile wildcard, or `doctor --fix`. Manual pilot/safety authority preempts agent plans. Degraded/unsupported capability remains visible.

## Acceptance Criteria

Every mechanism has a versioned contract and owner; all historical domain verbs map losslessly through the eleven operations; observation and effect authority stay separate; exact profile and final preconditions guard any future effect; obligations and indeterminacy are visible; no bypass route exists across CLI, MCP, NDJSON, adapters, workers, repair, handoff, or memory.

## Test Plan

Create `scripts/test_agent_control_transfer.py` and `scripts/e2e/cold_agent_witnessed_effect_protocol.sh`. Cover cold arrival, stale/gap packet, propose/compare/commit/watch, refusal, unavailable device effect, one-variable profile qualification, lease expiry, stale fence, lost response, duplicate request, lookup/reconcile, cancellation, long obligation, compact-profile invariant preservation, compatibility downgrade, sealed doctor repair, malicious content/path/command strings, memory advice, and handoff resume.

Logs retain session/turn/anchor/profile/capability/plan/request/effect/lease/fence/obligation IDs, compiled steps and preconditions, device/transport/observation stages, packet omissions/budget, recovery/repair/handoff, input/output digests, timings, and terminal verdict.

## Considerations

The shared control shape is valuable, but FDGR device scope remains constitutionally constrained. Do not turn a future D5-D9 target into current authority merely because the protocol can represent it.
acceptance_criteria: All 15 Dwarf Fortress control-loop mechanisms and non-bypass rules map to the canonical eleven-operation FDGR waist with exact anchors, witnessed effects, degraded compatibility, leases/obligations/doctor/memory boundaries, and cold-agent fault tests; no legacy verb or device adapter gains alternate authority.

title: VS-01: Agent-driven evidence-grade recorded reference reconstruction
description:
Outcome
Demonstrate the first useful end-to-end product: an agent drives an evidence-grade reconstruction from owner-authorized recorded media through the deterministic reference lane, without a neural model and without metric overclaim.

User story and sequence
A cold agent opens a session, orients from one canonical Agent Turn Packet, creates/updates the objective and question graph, and uses typed fdgr.propose -> fdgr.commit operations. The system imports exact original media with source/custody receipt; runs sealed ffprobe/media sidecars; builds packet/frame/clock ledgers; selects deterministic keyframes; computes classical features/tracks and relative camera/point state; exposes progress through fdgr.watch; verifies and atomically publishes a relative-only evidence product; then records an episode, surprises/costs, context pack, report/export, checkpoint, and handoff. Cancellation, process crash, replay, and fresh-agent resume are part of the same slice.

Boundaries
No neural model is required or silently substituted. Never emit meters or absolute position from relative scale. Derived assets never overwrite originals. Raw observations remain distinct from refined states. Every operation preserves exact compatible anchors, epistemic class, authority posture, active/indeterminate work, uncertainty, coverage, budgets, recovery, and typed next steps. comments.text:
Binding executable evidence namespace for wp_021 under WP-000/N06.10:

- scripts/test/wp_021_coverage_and_next_best_view.sh is the deterministic suite runner. It enumerates the exact owning-crate unit tests plus property/metamorphic and differential cases from the manifest; no test may exist only as prose.
- scripts/fault/wp_021_coverage_and_next_best_view.sh runs all applicable malformed-input, kill-point, cancellation, crash, pressure, restart, recovery, reconciliation and leak campaigns. A pure scalar kernel records inapplicable async faults by approved semantic class while its surrounding effect boundary still receives cancellation/recovery coverage.
- scripts/e2e/wp_021_coverage_and_next_best_view.sh runs the real package-local full path and emits or executes the product-public deferred replay. It exercises success, typed refusal, stale/invalid basis, restart/resume, readback and semantic completion through the minimum real boundaries—never mocks the behavior under test.

The package-local E2E is required for this V04 and Q05. If the eleven-operation public waist is not yet qualified, the product replay is sealed as deferred_by_dependency with exact prerequisite WP/gate and closure owner; it is not passed, skipped or made a backward dependency. Once prerequisites exist, the responsible public-waist or vertical-slice gate must execute it and cannot release with an eligible stale deferral.

All three runners implement --case, --seed, --schedule, --fixture-root, --profile, --offline, --receipt-dir, --keep-repro and --format. They emit canonical fdgr.test_event/1 NDJSON plus fdgr.test_receipt/1 containing suite/case/attempt, anchor/basis and input roots, source/tree/closure/toolchain/lock/model/license/policy/schema roots, host/hardware/profile/privacy class, transitions, budgets/pressure/timings, outputs/artifact/log digests, coverage/omissions/counterevidence, cancellation/drain/descendants, recovery/reconciliation, expected-versus-observed state, minimized repro and terminal verdict. Unknown versions/fields, missing required dimensions, mixed attempts, secret/private-path leaks, pass-with-unrun cases and noncanonical ordering fail closed.

This V04 cannot close until its manifest row resolves every named TEST/GATE/SLO/QL predicate to exact owner tests, fixtures and these runners; all deterministic positive and negative cases pass, while unsupported/failed/blocked/indeterminate/unrun evidence remains explicit.

Fresh-eyes qualification expansion: exhaustive Agent Acceptance Scenario matrix

Treat docs/AGENT_ACCEPTANCE_SCENARIOS.md as normative behavior, and make the following matrix self-contained in WP-044. Each scenario requires deterministic positive/negative fixtures where applicable, a public CLI/MCP/NDJSON E2E script, stable structured logs, exact input/source/toolchain/model/policy roots, packet/anchor IDs, state transitions, budgets/timings, output digests, omissions, recovery, descendant drain, and a terminal verdict. Validate semantic equivalence across supported public surfaces, not byte identity where transport envelopes legitimately differ.

A-001 cold campaign arrival: one briefing exposes continuity, authority, active work, top questions, and minimum-cost safe next action. A-002 unchanged pulse: compact byte-stable heartbeat, no unchanged inventory, hazards retained. A-003 delta after capture: exact basis/target continuity, only semantic changes, no mixed generation. A-004 clock reset: reset state, invalidated handles/plans, recovery, new epoch. A-005 question context: sufficient diverse evidence plus explicit omissions and Pack DNA. A-006 model disagreement: separate proposals, counterevidence, resolution path, no forced merge. A-007 metric refusal: relative reconstruction cannot satisfy metric request; offer scale-witness affordance. A-008 coverage-limited absence: empty search never becomes absence without coverage/detectability witness. A-009 candidate frontier: same basis/policy yields deterministic nondominated set and dominance certificates. A-010 budget exhaustion: decision-useful complete prefix, omissions, and sealed continuation. A-011 active-obligation handoff: fresh agent resumes without transcript or hidden state. A-012 indeterminate upload/device effect: reconcile before retry and preserve visibility in every packet. A-013 live pilot: one primary instruction, fallback, safety, expected/observed gain. A-014 surprise: prediction divergence becomes durable surprise and episode evidence. A-015 policy non-bypass: lessons, recommendations, memories, counterfactuals, and feedback cannot issue capabilities or weaken gates. A-016 multi-agent overlap: lease/witness conflict with deterministic rebase or branch. A-017 no useful action: zero-action/stop is valid and explained. A-018 error pedagogy: error preserves still-valid state and exact minimum repair. A-019 semantic zoom: campaign -> raw anchor -> campaign without identity drift. A-020 live/reference parity: equivalent semantic state yields equivalent packet semantics and recommendation order. A-021 frame-only continuation: fresh agent chooses correct next step from one packet plus named expansions. A-022 attention hysteresis: unchanged state does not reinterrupt; material contradiction re-enters. A-023 spatial refinement: old landmark resolves through split/supersession or exact ambiguity. A-024 pilot refusal: cannot_comply retires or replans instruction; never marks execution. A-025 safety preemption: critical flight state displaces normal work while unfinished questions remain. A-026 decision-theoretic stop: choose do-nothing when expected evidence cannot justify total resource/operator/flight/risk cost. A-027 canonical vocabulary: schemas, CLI, MCP, NDJSON, receipts, examples, and self-description use registry-derived lower_snake_case and fdgr.<name>/1 schema identities.

Acceptance requires all 27 scenario receipts against the same source fence and current roots, with failures/unsupported cases retained individually. No aggregate percentage may conceal a failed critical scenario. A cold agent must be able to understand state, choose the minimum-cost safe next action, verify completion, and leave a sufficient handoff without source access or transcript replay.

comments.text:
Fresh-eyes qualification expansion: exhaustive Agent Acceptance Scenario matrix

Treat docs/AGENT_ACCEPTANCE_SCENARIOS.md as normative behavior, and make the following matrix self-contained in WP-044. Each scenario requires deterministic positive/negative fixtures where applicable, a public CLI/MCP/NDJSON E2E script, stable structured logs, exact input/source/toolchain/model/policy roots, packet/anchor IDs, state transitions, budgets/timings, output digests, omissions, recovery, descendant drain, and a terminal verdict. Validate semantic equivalence across supported public surfaces, not byte identity where transport envelopes legitimately differ.

A-001 cold campaign arrival: one briefing exposes continuity, authority, active work, top questions, and minimum-cost safe next action. A-002 unchanged pulse: compact byte-stable heartbeat, no unchanged inventory, hazards retained. A-003 delta after capture: exact basis/target continuity, only semantic changes, no mixed generation. A-004 clock reset: reset state, invalidated handles/plans, recovery, new epoch. A-005 question context: sufficient diverse evidence plus explicit omissions and Pack DNA. A-006 model disagreement: separate proposals, counterevidence, resolution path, no forced merge. A-007 metric refusal: relative reconstruction cannot satisfy metric request; offer scale-witness affordance. A-008 coverage-limited absence: empty search never becomes absence without coverage/detectability witness. A-009 candidate frontier: same basis/policy yields deterministic nondominated set and dominance certificates. A-010 budget exhaustion: decision-useful complete prefix, omissions, and sealed continuation. A-011 active-obligation handoff: fresh agent resumes without transcript or hidden state. A-012 indeterminate upload/device effect: reconcile before retry and preserve visibility in every packet. A-013 live pilot: one primary instruction, fallback, safety, expected/observed gain. A-014 surprise: prediction divergence becomes durable surprise and episode evidence. A-015 policy non-bypass: lessons, recommendations, memories, counterfactuals, and feedback cannot issue capabilities or weaken gates. A-016 multi-agent overlap: lease/witness conflict with deterministic rebase or branch. A-017 no useful action: zero-action/stop is valid and explained. A-018 error pedagogy: error preserves still-valid state and exact minimum repair. A-019 semantic zoom: campaign -> raw anchor -> campaign without identity drift. A-020 live/reference parity: equivalent semantic state yields equivalent packet semantics and recommendation order. A-021 frame-only continuation: fresh agent chooses correct next step from one packet plus named expansions. A-022 attention hysteresis: unchanged state does not reinterrupt; material contradiction re-enters. A-023 spatial refinement: old landmark resolves through split/supersession or exact ambiguity. A-024 pilot refusal: cannot_comply retires or replans instruction; never marks execution. A-025 safety preemption: critical flight state displaces normal work while unfinished questions remain. A-026 decision-theoretic stop: choose do-nothing when expected evidence cannot justify total resource/operator/flight/risk cost. A-027 canonical vocabulary: schemas, CLI, MCP, NDJSON, receipts, examples, and self-description use registry-derived lower_snake_case and fdgr.<name>/1 schema identities.

Acceptance requires all 27 scenario receipts against the same source fence and current roots, with failures/unsupported cases retained individually. No aggregate percentage may conceal a failed critical scenario. A cold agent must be able to understand state, choose the minimum-cost safe next action, verify completion, and leave a sufficient handoff without source access or transcript replay.

Binding executable evidence namespace for wp_047 under WP-000/N06.10:

- scripts/test/wp_047_spatial_handles_and_human_agent_flight.sh is the deterministic suite runner. It enumerates the exact owning-crate unit tests plus property/metamorphic and differential cases from the manifest; no test may exist only as prose.
- scripts/fault/wp_047_spatial_handles_and_human_agent_flight.sh runs all applicable malformed-input, kill-point, cancellation, crash, pressure, restart, recovery, reconciliation and leak campaigns. - scripts/e2e/wp_047_spatial_handles_and_human_agent_flight.sh runs the real package-local full path and emits or executes the product-public deferred replay. This V04 cannot close until its manifest row resolves every named TEST/GATE/SLO/QL predicate to exact owner tests, fixtures and these runners; all deterministic positive and negative cases pass, while unsupported/failed/blocked/indeterminate/unrun evidence remains explicit.
